description.value: The Keg Steakhouse + Bar is a well-known Canadian steakhouse chain with a recently renovated Abbotsford location situated just off Highway 1 at Sumas Way. The restaurant features a full lounge and bar with televisions, a semi-private dining room, and patio seating, making it a comfortable stop for a sit-down meal after a long day in the saddle. Free parking and wheelchair accessibility round out the practical amenities at this location.
